name: ghadiag
description: A standalone GitHub Actions workflow and action validator powered by official @actions/languageservice
author: Kenichi Kamiya <kachick1@gmail.com>

scripts.check_no_git_diff: (git add --intent-to-add . && git diff --exit-code) || (echo 'You should commit all diff before running tests'; exit 1)
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && node ./dist/cli.js
